decisions.reason: The candidate already separately governs removal and category consolidation. Adding or rewording modern questions belongs to the modernization Requirement and does not alter the candidate's existing curation rules.
The modernization actions do not themselves change answer-layer structure. Message 18 already has a separate candidate Event covering newly added questions and the required answer layers.
General authority to introduce or reword questions does not change this specific chapter's topic, format, or question-count rule.
The modernization options do not change the specific remote and hybrid leadership chapter requirement.
Adding or rewording questions remains subject to the existing word budget but does not change any word-budget attribute.
The general modernization actions do not alter this chapter's specific topic, format, or question-count policy.
The source decision concerns modernization of question content and does not change the non-Q&A AI preparation chapter.
The source decision concerns question-set modernization and does not alter the non-Q&A pre-interview preparation chapter.
The modernization proposals remain subject to editorial approval, but the approval Requirement already has a same-message Event covering additions, removals, and other proposed revisions.
Modernizing questions for today's workplace does not necessarily alter the independently specified global-perspective content or integration method.
The source adds modernization options but does not change the Google Doc, suggesting-mode, or deletion-rationale workflow.
Question-content modernization does not change the companion-resource package, delivery channel, examples, or asset expectations.
